visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a busy city sidewalk with numerous scooters parked along the curb. A young woman with short dark hair and a gray fuzzy jacket enters the frame, looking directly at the camera with an exaggerated, energetic expression. She points aggressively toward the screen while speaking. The lighting is bright natural daylight in an urban setting with multi-story buildings and bare winter trees in the background. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up shot of a smartphone held in the woman's hands. The screen displays a photo gallery with many selfies. Her fingers interact with the screen, selecting a specific photo and swiping up to reveal metadata including a map. The background is a slightly blurred city sidewalk with gray paving stones. (3) Back to a medium shot, the woman walks along the sidewalk, looking around. She points toward a line of parked scooters. Several cars, including a white SUV and a gray sedan, are visible in the street background. The camera moves with her in a handheld, slightly shaky fashion. (4) A final close-up of the phone shows a grid of funny facial expressions before cutting to a shot of a pink and white brand banner that reads 'aotter' and mentions 'Cafe & Tea Space'. The video concludes with a brief, high-contrast black-and-white meme clip of a man in a hat wiping his forehead in disbelief.

The high-energy narration and meme-style editing aim to capture viewers' attention while linking the brand to a physical community or office space.
